description: This file defines error handling macros for assertions and error checks in C, including assertions for general errors, errno, POSIX errors, and memory allocation failures. It also includes licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: likely
methods.description: Defines branch prediction hint for likely true condition.

methods.name: unlikely
methods.description: Defines branch prediction hint for unlikely true condition.

methods.name: mapf_assert
methods.description: Asserts a condition; aborts if false, printing an error message.

methods.name: errno_assert
methods.description: Checks an errno-style error condition; aborts if true, printing error string.

methods.name: posix_assert
methods.description: Checks a POSIX error condition; aborts if true, printing error string.

methods.name: alloc_assert
methods.description: Checks memory allocation success; aborts if failed.
